headline: California Targets Nvidia in Probe Over China AI Chip Shipments
summary: California authorities have opened an investigation into Nvidia regarding artificial intelligence chips supplied to China. The probe into the Santa Clara-based chipmaker follows the departure of former chief executive Jensen Huang.
why: Nvidia is the leading designer of high-performance graphics processors used in training AI models. Heightened regulatory scrutiny over sales to China introduces legal risk and potential limits on addressable market demand.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia is facing regulatory scrutiny from California officials over its AI chip business in China.
